notes: SMOG was normed on 30-sentence samples; this text has 14, so the SMOG score is extrapolated.

references.note: Reference ranges are for vocd-D (Durán et al. 2004), which lexinspect computes as `vocd_d` following McKee, Malvern & Richards (2000). Compare them with vocd-D only — HD-D (0–1) and MTLD are on different scales.

cefr.caveat: Heuristic only. Based on CEFR-J 1.5 + Octanove C1/C2 1.0; not Cambridge EVP. Cite both sources. Combine this with readability, BNC/COCA and diversity signals before reporting a level.

dictionary.licence: LibreOffice English. en_GB: wordlist and affix file (David Bartlett, Andrew Brown) under the LGPL. en_US: wordlist from SCOWL by Kevin Atkinson (permissive SCOWL licence); affix file from Geoff Kuenning's Ispell (BSD). Mirror: github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries.

errors.caveat: Hunspell-based detection: it flags words its dictionary doesn't contain, so rare technical terms and neologisms can appear as errors, and a real word used wrongly (their/there) is not caught. Capitalised words used as names are listed separately, not counted as errors. Dictionaries: LibreOffice English (en_GB: LGPL; en_US: SCOWL wordlist, Ispell BSD affix file).
